newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Votorantim started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Votorantim started as buy.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said it has initiated coverage of Brazilian pulp and paper firm Votorantim Celulose e Papel with a buy recommendation.
-- The brokerage said in a report it the market is miscalculating the value of the firm's stock based on earnings and past performance.
-- "Depreciation is hiding the value and past charges were non-cash or have the potential to improve year-on-year performance," Fator said.
-- The brokerage said the company is expanding to a higher-margin product mix and plans to boost pulp capacityin 1997.
-- Fator has set a 12-month target price for the company's stock at 24.00 reais, up about 30 percent from current prices.
-- Votorantim Celulose preferred was off 0.44 reais at 17.55 reais at 1139 local/0839 EDT on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange.
